summary: Re-run Gemma 4 12B against the full 514-case dataset using the existing scripts/eval/backtest_runner.py with Phase G+H stack and bge-reranker active. The Qwen 9B baseline at eval/results/final-postfix/20260609T205731/raw.jsonl (261 cases, judged by deepseek-chat-v3.1) is the comparison side; we only need to extend Gemma from the 96-case stratified phaseA/B/variance runs to a fair 514-case full-stack run. The chat-response cache (Phase D) is keyed on (model, endpoint, corpus) so flipping OLLAMA_MODEL to gemma forces a new chat_sha and re-issues live /chat calls for Gemma while the deepseek judge replies cache freely on repeat ids. Output: two raw.jsonl files (Qwen + Gemma) -> eval/scripts/build_comparison_tables.py -> per_case.md (truncated to 280 chars/cell, full strings in appendix.jsonl) + aggregate.md (strict/weighted/per-defect side-by-side) + manual_verification_log.md (user_live_test=true block reconstructed from this session's /chat calls Claude made earlier). Recommend the FULL 514 (not the stratified 300) because (a) only ~78 Ollama-minutes more than 300 at parallel=2, (b) lets us reuse the 261 Qwen rows by id-join without resampling, (c) yields stable Wilson CIs per (domain x language) cell. Stratified 300 is the fallback if wallclock is the binding constraint.
runner_commands:
# 1. Bring up the dev stack with Gemma 4 12B as the active Ollama model
# (assumes the Ollama Docker container is already pulled per project_ollama_migration.md)
docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d
docker exec ollama ollama pull gemma2:12b

# 2. Confirm Phase G + H.A + H.B + H.C are wired in the hotel_guardrails config
#    (rerank=bge-reranker-v2-m3, retriever=hybrid, breadcrumbs on)
#    Sanity: /healthz returns 200 and lists 'rerank.model=bge-reranker-v2-m3'
curl -s http://localhost:8088/healthz | jq '.rerank, .retriever, .phase_flags'

# 3. Export the model env vars the runner snapshots into manifest.json
$env:OLLAMA_MODEL  = 'gemma2:12b'
$env:APP_LLM_MODELNAME = 'gemma2:12b'
$env:OPENROUTER_API_KEY = (Get-Content .env | Select-String 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY' | %% { ($_ -split '=',2)[1] })

# 4. Smoke-test 15 canaries first; abort if >2 fail
python scripts/eval/backtest_runner.py `
    --tag gemma4-full-stack-canary `
    --endpoint http://localhost:8088 `
    --canaries-only `
    --chat-cache-version gemma4-h-stack-v1 `
    --max-chat-parallel 2 `
    --abort-canary-failures 2

# 5. FULL 514-case run (golden EN/TH/CN + hard_neg + adversarial + canaries + multi_intent_and_out_of_kb).
#    Phase D chat cache ON: keyed on (model=gemma2:12b, endpoint, corpus_sha, version),
#    so this is a cold cache for Gemma but warm for the judge across resumes.
#    parallel=2 keeps Ollama GPU queue saturated without OOM on a 12B model.
python scripts/eval/backtest_runner.py `
    --tag gemma4-full-stack `
    --endpoint http://localhost:8088 `
    --judge-model deepseek/deepseek-chat-v3.1 `
    --chat-timeout 240 `
    --chat-cache-version gemma4-h-stack-v1 `
    --max-chat-parallel 2 `
    --abort-canary-failures 2

# 6. Generate the standard per-stratum + watchlist report for the Gemma run
python scripts/eval/backtest_report.py --tag gemma4-full-stack `
    --compare-to eval/results/final-postfix/20260609T205731

# 7. Build the thesis side-by-side comparison artifacts
python eval/scripts/build_comparison_tables.py `
    --qwen-raw  eval/results/final-postfix/20260609T205731/raw.jsonl `
    --gemma-raw eval/results/gemma4-full-stack/<TS>/raw.jsonl `
    --dataset-dir eval/dataset `
    --out-dir eval/results/comparison/qwen9b_vs_gemma4_12b `
    --truncate-chars 280 `
    --live-test-log eval/results/comparison/manual_verification_log.json

# Fallback (stratified 300) if wallclock-bound:
python scripts/eval/backtest_runner.py --tag gemma4-full-stack-s300 `
    --sample-iteration 300 --sample-seed 42 `
    --endpoint http://localhost:8088 --chat-cache-version gemma4-h-stack-v1 `
    --max-chat-parallel 2

per_case_table_design.sort_order: language ASC (en, th, cn), then domain ASC, then subdomain ASC, then complexity ASC, then id ASC. Within each block, rows where qwen_verdict != gemma_verdict float to the top (regression/improvement rows surface first). Cases present in only one raw.jsonl get a single-side row tagged missing_other=true and sorted to the end of their language block.
per_case_table_design.truncation_policy: Inline cells are hard-truncated to 280 chars with a trailing ' ...' marker; the build script also writes the full untruncated response for every (id, model) pair into appendix_full_responses.jsonl alongside per_case.md. Markdown table cells additionally escape pipes (|->\|) and newlines (\n -> ' / ') so GFM rendering stays intact. expected_facts and must_contain_any are rendered as inline-code comma-joined arrays (no truncation, they are short by construction). The delta column is one of {match, regression, improvement, both_fail, missing_other} computed from (qwen_verdict, gemma_verdict).

metrics: strict_pass_rate = correct / n  (with Wilson 95% CI per model)
McNemar p-value on paired verdicts (correct vs not) for matched ids
per_language_pass_rate (en / th / cn) for both models, with CIs

per_defect_rate per category from the fixed taxonomy: rag_miss, rag_drift, room_conflation, spec_wrong, incomplete, tool_not_called, tool_error, hallucination, language_leak, tool_call_leak, particle_mismatch, wrong_routing, empty_response, format_error, over_refuse (count + rate per model + delta)
language_leak rate split by reply language
mean_chat_latency_s + p95 (per model, live calls only, chat_source=='live')
judge_source breakdown (deepseek vs precheck_shortcircuit vs deterministic_fallback) per model -- so we can prove the verdicts aren't disproportionately fallback-tainted on one side
aggregate_comparison_design.side_by_side_layout: aggregate.md has three sections. (1) Headline: two-row markdown table with columns [Model | n | strict_pass | weighted_pass | hallucination | language_leak | mean_latency_s], rows Qwen 9B / Gemma 4 12B, then a single 'Delta' row in pp. (2) Per-language: 3-column-group table (en/th/cn) x 2 rows (model). (3) Per-defect: one row per defect tag, columns [Defect | Qwen count | Qwen rate | Gemma count | Gemma rate | Delta (pp) | Sign]. A footer note records (a) joinable_n and any unmatched_ids on either side, (b) the McNemar p-value with df=1, (c) the manifest sha (workflow_sha, embedding_model, llm_model, judge_model) for both runs so the table is provenance-complete for the thesis.

live_test_capture: "During this session Claude (the assistant) issued ad-hoc Python POST /chat probes against http://localhost:8088 while iterating on the Phase G+H stack. Capture them as a separate appendix block flagged user_live_test=true so they are visually and structurally distinct from the dataset-driven raw.jsonl rows: (1) build_comparison_tables.py accepts --live-test-log <path.json> pointing at eval/results/comparison/manual_verification_log.json; (2) the file is a JSON array of objects with the schema {turn_idx:int, timestamp_iso:str, model_active:'qwen9b'|'gemma4-12b', question:str, response:str, claude_qualitative_judgement:str, qualitative_verdict:'pass'|'fail'|'mixed', user_live_test:true, source:'claude_session_<id>', notes:str}; (3) the script renders these into a separate markdown block titled '## Appendix C - Manual verification log (user_live_test=true)' appended after the dataset comparison tables, with a top-of-section callout > NOTE: These rows are NOT part of the 514-case scored dataset. They are interactive live probes run by Claude during the design session and are included for qualitative transparency only -- they do not feed the aggregate pass rates above; (4) each row also gets a 'rerun_id' field so the case can be re-issued through backtest_runner.py later if we want to promote it into the formal dataset; (5) for the initial pass the JSON log is reconstructed by replaying this session's transcript (the assistant grep's its own earlier tool-call records for hit_chat / requests.post / urllib calls to /chat and emits one object per call); going forward, a tiny wrapper scripts/eval/log_live_chat.py will tee every interactive /chat probe into this file automatically so the appendix stays current."
post_processing_script: "Create eval/scripts/build_comparison_tables.py. CLI: --qwen-raw <path> --gemma-raw <path> --dataset-dir eval/dataset --out-dir eval/results/comparison/<name> --truncate-chars 280 [--live-test-log <path.json>] [--joinable-only] [--include-missing]. Behavior: (1) load_jsonl on both raw paths and on every dataset/*.jsonl (golden_{en,th,cn}, hard_negatives, adversarial, canaries, multi_intent_and_out_of_kb) to build dataset_by_id; rows missing in the dataset map are dropped with a stderr warning. (2) Inner-join the two raw files on id; collect outer-join unmatched_ids per side. (3) For each joined case build a per_case row by pulling question/expected_facts/must_contain_any/must_not_contain from dataset_by_id and response/verdict/defects/dimension_scores from each raw row; compute delta_class in {match, regression(qwen=correct,gemma!=correct), improvement(qwen!=correct,gemma=correct), both_fail, both_partial, missing_other}. (4) Render per_case.md as a single GFM table sorted per the design above; cells truncated via _trunc(s, n) that strips pipes/newlines and appends ' ...' when len>n; also write appendix_full_responses.jsonl with {id, model, response_full, defects, reason} per row (no truncation). (5) Compute aggregates: strict_pass = sum(v=='correct')/n, weighted = (correct + 0.5*partial)/n, Wilson 95% CI via scripts/eval/backtest_common.wilson_ci (already imported by backtest_report), per-language and per-defect breakdowns by iterating the fixed taxonomy list, McNemar via scipy.stats if available else a NumPy-free pure-Python implementation (b,c off-diagonal counts -> chi2 = (|b-c|-1)**2 / (b+c)). (6) Render aggregate.md with the three sections from aggregate_comparison_design.side_by_side_layout; embed both run manifests (workflow_sha, llm_model, judge_model, corpus_sha) in a 'Provenance' fenced YAML block at the top. (7) If --live-test-log is passed, load the JSON array, sort by turn_idx, and render Appendix C exactly as described in live_test_capture, including the callout. (8) Emit a summary.json with the headline numbers + delta + McNemar p so a downstream LaTeX figure script (gen_fig_6_X_qwen_vs_gemma.py) can read it without re-parsing markdown. (9) Idempotent: re-running on the same inputs overwrites cleanly. (10) Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 if join cardinality < 50 (refuse to write a misleading comparison), 2 internal error. Wire it up so `python eval/scripts/build_comparison_tables.py --qwen-raw eval/results/final-postfix/20260609T205731/raw.jsonl --gemma-raw eval/results/gemma4-full-stack/<TS>/raw.jsonl --dataset-dir eval/dataset --out-dir eval/results/comparison/qwen9b_vs_gemma4_12b` produces per_case.md, appendix_full_responses.jsonl, aggregate.md, summary.json (+ manual_verification_log.md appendix if the flag is set)."
